svg.title: Interconnection Cost per kW Across Cluster Studies
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-interconnection-cost-per-kw-comparison; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Interconnection Cost per kW Across Cluster Studies; subtitle: Cost follows impact, not MW, and your costs are coupled to your neighbors; total range: $0 to $2,700/kW across cited interconnection cost studies; caption: Price the withdrawal ladder before posting; on 200 MW with $178M allocated, exits run $8.9M at 5%, $17.88M at 10% and $35.6M at 20% (Keentel Engineering).; assumptions note: Buckets compare cited per-kW figures from different regions and datasets; they are not additive. Single-value buckets carry equal low and high values.; note: Attributed to Environmental Defense Fund, Sarah Johnson (M62wgLYBKBw), and Keentel Engineering (TM7qt8CCWxk).; buckets: label: PJM cost, median to 90th percentile; low: 50; high: 400; notes: Hand-collected PJM dataset of about 4,000 requests and 7,000 studies (Environmental Defense Fund).; label: Kill-risk flag line; low: 100; high: 100; notes: Above $100/kW makes withdrawal 22 percentage points more likely; 13% of estimates move more than $100/kW between studies.; label: ISO-NE transitional cluster allocation; low: 0; high: 2700; notes: 23 projects, 4,826.5 MW, $3.21B total upgrade cost; $0 to $541M per project (Keentel Engineering).; label: Install cost reference; low: 1500; high: 1500; notes: Roughly $1,500/kW to install, the benchmark against which the PJM cost tail is read.
